enchantments.tooltip: +13 Enhancement Bonus: +13 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Elf Bane 6: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt those who are attuned to nature, dealing an additional 6d10 bane damage vs. Elves.

Axiomatic 6: This weapon is righteous and wielded by those who stand against chaos, dealing an additional 6d6 law damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon lawfully aligned. (Chaotic characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level.)
Sovereign Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 3000 Hit Points, they take 300 damage.
Maiming: This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +6d8 damage.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
